strategies.name: ema_support_scalp_long
strategies.entry_summary: After the first 5 to 15 minutes, watch the 5-minute chart for price to pull back to support, especially where the 13 EMA is acting as initial support. Enter on the bounce off that support or demand zone.
strategies.exit_summary: Take profit quickly at resistance; the speaker repeatedly frames the trade as getting in and out, seeing profit and not overstaying your welcome.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for the first 5 to 15 minutes to pass, then enter on the bounce off the 13 EMA/support
variants.target_note: exit at resistance for a quick scalp
variants.transcript_quote: time your entries once you have allowed the first 5 to 15 minutes to pass ... look at this indicator the 13 EMA in this example on the 5 minute chart

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter off deeper support at the 200 EMA when the 13 EMA has lost support status
variants.target_note: ride it to resistance and exit
variants.transcript_quote: now we have formed this is your exit ... another quick Scout this one off a deeper support sitting at the 200 EMA once the 13 EMA gave up its support

strategies.name: breakdown_continuation_short
strategies.entry_summary: When price loses the support level, especially after losing the 200 EMA support, enter in the direction of the breakdown for the big move lower.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit into the downside move after the breakdown; the speaker marks the takeaway as the large move that follows the loss of support, with the exit shown at the point where the drop has already unfolded.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter once support of the 200 EMA is lost
variants.target_note: exit at the lower move after the breakdown
variants.transcript_quote: once we lost the support of the 200 look at this move boom boom boom you want to exit right there ... you would enter here and you had that coming all

result.enumeration_note: The transcript teaches one long scalp family with two compatible support-based variants, plus a separate downside breakdown strategy taught after support fails; the long and short teachings are oppositional and therefore split.
